Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Foundations team is a new, dedicated team within Growth focused on establishing foundational frontend infrastructure, best practices, and component systems that serve Kraken's entire .com platform. We are building the standards and tools that enable all frontend development across the organization to move faster, maintain higher quality, and align with modern development practices. The team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Design to create a robust component library and establish best practices that set the gold standard for frontend development at Kraken. Our mission is to empower teams across the organization with well-architected, reusable components and clear guidelines that accelerate development while ensuring consistency, quality, and maintainability across all Kraken customer-facing experiences.

This is a fast-moving, delivery-focused team. You'll ship a steady stream of projects rather than settle into long-term platform maintenance, and the work is very UI-heavy.

 

The opportunity

  • Design, build, and ship a comprehensive component library and design system using React.js and our custom-built CMS that serves as the foundation for all .com experiences

  • Build and document reusable, accessible components and integrate with our custom CMS to enable dynamic content management and component configuration across the platform

  • Deliver polished, pixel-perfect UI implementations that faithfully translate designs into production, working closely with Design to get every detail right

  • Move quickly across multiple projects and initiatives, balancing speed of delivery with quality

  • Establish and evolve frontend best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns that become the model for development across the organization

  • Create comprehensive component documentation and guidelines that empower developers across teams to build consistently and efficiently

  • Set the standard for high-quality code, mentor junior and senior engineers, and significantly influence technical decisions and strategy discussions

  • Design and implement scalable, well-documented systems that support growth and complexity across multiple teams and initiatives

  • Optimize component performance, accessibility, and developer experience to accelerate team velocity and reduce friction in the development workflow

  • Drive process improvements and lead by example, establishing patterns and practices that become foundational to frontend development at Kraken

What you bring

  • A keen eye for design and a passion for pixel-perfect implementation

  • A strong understanding of component-driven design and reusable architecture patterns

  • Experience building and maintaining design systems or component libraries at scale

  • A track record of thriving in fast-paced environments and delivering projects quickly

  • A passion for establishing best practices and improving developer experience across teams

  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers across the organization

Skills you should HODL

  • 4+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on web and component-driven applications

  • Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and proficiency with React framework

  • Strong UI engineering skills, including advanced CSS and translating design mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces

  • Experience building or contributing to design systems or component libraries

  • Strong experience with modern frontend build tools and tooling (webpack, vite, etc.)

  • Experience with API design and integration (RESTful APIs, GraphQL)

  • Proficiency with frontend testing frameworks and component testing best practices

  • Experience working with or integrating a CMS (custom-built or headless)

  • Strong understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and UI/UX best practices

  • Experience within a large technology organization or fast-growing startup

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to haves

  • Knowledge of the cryptocurrency industry and blockchain technology

  • Experience with Next.js and server-side rendering patterns

  • Familiarity with TypeScript in a large codebase

  • Experience mentoring other engineers on component architecture and best practices

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table.   • Act as the CEO's strategic thinking partner on company priorities, key decisions, and tradeoffs, and represent the CEO with the exec team, board, partners, and investors

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

 

Every hire on TRM's recruiting team is a force multiplier for our mission. The faster we scale Marketing and the go-to-market teams it powers, the faster our blockchain intelligence reaches the investigators, compliance teams, and agencies working to stop financial crime. As a Marketing Recruiter (Contract), you'll run full-cycle recruiting across our Marketing organization at one of the most consequential moments in TRM's growth.

 

You'll partner directly with marketing leaders and hiring managers to translate ambitious growth goals into concrete hiring plans, design candidate experiences that reflect the seriousness of our mission, and build the scalable recruiting practices a globally distributed, async-first company runs on. Your impact will show up not just in who joins TRM, but in how well we compete for world-class marketing talent as our brand and market presence grow.

What you’ll do:

  • Run full-cycle hiring across Marketing, including Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Brand and Content, Communications, Field and Events, Marketing Operations, and Creative, owning each search from intake to close.

  • Partner with marketing leaders and hiring managers to define talent needs, set hiring strategy, and deliver against the growth priorities tied to TRM's expansion across public sector, financial institutions, and crypto.

  • Design candidate experiences that convey why TRM's work matters and reflect our high talent bar at every touchpoint, knowing that marketing candidates will judge us by how well we tell our own story.

  • Build market maps and creative sourcing strategies to reach high-caliber marketers in competitive markets where the best people are rarely looking.

  • Build proactive pipelines of Product Marketing and Demand Generation talent so TRM can move quickly as new priorities, segments, or regions emerge.

  • Help hiring teams evaluate portfolios, work samples, and case exercises fairly and consistently.

  • Sharpen our recruiting processes, interview practices, and workflows to drive speed, quality, and consistency as we scale.

  • Use hiring data and market insight to advise teams on compensation, talent availability, and role design, unblock searches, and make sound recruiting decisions.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, with a strong track record hiring across marketing functions such as Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Brand, Content, and Communications.

  • Experience recruiting for B2B marketing teams, ideally in SaaS, security, fintech, or other technical and regulated markets.

  • Proven success recruiting in high-growth, fast-paced environments where priorities shift frequently.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and executives, including CMOs and marketing VPs, as a strategic talent advisor.

  • A working understanding of how modern marketing teams operate and are measured, so you can tell the difference between a strong pipeline builder, a sharp storyteller, and a great operator.

  • The ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar specialties and turn business needs into clear, credible hiring profiles.

  • Strong sourcing skills and the ability to build pipelines in markets where top talent is passive and in demand.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of niche, strategic searches without sacrificing attention to detail or candidate experience.

  • Excellent communication and a structured, proactive, async-friendly working style.

  • Sound judgment, high ownership, and the composure to operate with urgency and ambiguity across a globally distributed team.

  • A candidate-first mindset and commitment to delivering exceptional experiences across roles and levels.

 

About the team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

  • We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

  • We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

  • We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

  • Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

  • Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

  • Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.

  • Within your first 30 days, you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.

  • Within your first 60 days, you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.

  • Within your first 90 days, you’ll have made 2–3 hires.

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team develops intelligent systems that help Stripe identify high-risk accounts, minimize credit losses, and improve profitability. Credit risk is a complex machine learning problem that requires us to distinguish emerging risk from healthy business activity while giving legitimate users a clear and reliable experience.

Our team consists of machine learning engineers who build models and systems used across Stripe’s credit-risk products. We work closely with partners in Product, Data Science, Credit Strategy, Operations, and other engineering teams. Together, we help stakeholders make informed decisions and support sustainable growth wherever credit risk affects Stripe’s products.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead the Credit Risk team and shape how Stripe uses machine learning to manage credit risk at scale. You’ll set the team’s technical and product direction, connect advances in machine learning to measurable business outcomes, and help engineers deliver reliable systems that balance loss prevention with the user experience.

You’ll work across engineering, product, data science, and risk to identify the highest-impact opportunities and turn them into a focused roadmap. You’ll also hire and develop engineers, strengthen the team’s technical practices, and contribute to machine learning and engineering leadership across Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the strategy for detecting and mitigating credit risk through machine learning
  • Own outcomes related to credit losses, profitability, detection quality, and the user experience
  • Lead the design and delivery of reliable machine learning models, services, and decision systems
  • Translate advances in machine learning into practical capabilities that support the team’s business goals
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Credit Strategy, Operations, and engineering teams to define priorities and deliver cross-functional programs
  • Recruit, hire, and develop machine learning engineers while building an inclusive and effective team
  • Contribute to broader engineering and machine learning initiatives as a member of Stripe’s engineering management team

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of experience managing engineers who build and operate production machine learning systems
  • Experience applying machine learning to complex, real-world problems and leading the technical delivery of models and supporting systems
  • Experience setting strategy and working across engineering, product, data science, operations, and business teams to deliver measurable outcomes
  • Experience recruiting, managing, and developing engineers in a fast-moving environment with significant autonomy

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with credit risk, fraud detection, financial risk, trust and safety, or another domain involving decisions under uncertainty
  • Experience balancing risk reduction with customer or user experience
  • Experience building machine learning systems that support high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions at scale
  • Experience setting a multi-year technical direction while delivering progress through quarterly plans
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams
